query: How does resolution time vary across issue themes, channel, and priority?

per_column.name: issue_theme
per_column.rationale: Directly provides the 'issue theme' axis the query explicitly calls for. Values (billing_invoicing, authentication_sso, performance, file_export_import) are sound readings of each source text. Strong grouping axis for resolution-time analysis.

per_column.name: ticket_class
per_column.rationale: A complementary categorical axis (bug/feature_request/outage/etc.) useful for comparing resolution times; partially overlaps issue_theme but offers a distinct type-of-work dimension. Values well-grounded, though CS-0002 as 'bug' vs config uncertainty is a defensible reading.

per_column.name: operational_impact
per_column.rationale: Severity/impact gives a genuine new modeling axis correlated with priority and resolution time. Mostly well-grounded, but 'revenue_at_risk' for CS-0001 (a corrected-invoice request already paid) is a stretch, and impact inferences are somewhat interpretive.

per_column.name: scope_of_impact
per_column.rationale: Breadth of impact (single_user vs all_users_single_tenant vs cross_tenant) is a meaningful axis distinct from severity and useful for explaining resolution variance. Values match the text well, with appropriate 'not_stated' for silent rows.

per_column.name: root_cause_class
per_column.rationale: Root cause offers analytical leverage on why resolution times differ. However groundedness is weaker: CS-0002 labeled 'configuration_error' when text only says user 'suspects' SSO config, and CS-0003 'infrastructure_failure' is inferred from a 502 without confirmation. Appropriate 'not_identified' fallback mitigates this.

per_column.name: requires_escalation
per_column.rationale: A binary flag largely inferable from priority/impact, adding limited independent leverage. Values are plausible but interpretive (e.g., CS-0003 True vs CS-0001 False), and the flag risks being a coarse restatement of severity signals.

judge.rationale: The added columns supply several genuine grouping/modeling axes directly serving the query (issue_theme, ticket_class, scope_of_impact, operational_impact), complementing the existing priority and channel columns for resolution-time analysis. Groundedness is generally strong with sensible 'not_stated'/'not_identified' handling of silent rows, though root_cause_class and operational_impact contain some interpretive leaps (e.g., 'revenue_at_risk', unconfirmed 'infrastructure_failure'). requires_escalation is the weakest, being a coarse, partly redundant flag. No egregious hallucinations observed.
